Central China Daily News (official organ of Wang Ching Wei)

ANNIVERSARY OF THE JANUARY 28TH INCIDENT

January 28 being the third anniversary of
the January 28th Incident, the local Tangpu will
hold a commemoration meeting at 9 a.m. on that day
at its auditorium at Foong Ling Jao, Nantao. The
Tangpu has notified various public bodies to detail
representatives to attend the meeting.
The local military and police authorities
will adopt precautionary measures in order to prevent
disturbances.

Central China Daily News (official organ of Wang Ching Wei)
and other local newspapers :

ARRIVAL OF CHINESE DEPORTEES FROM JAPAN

The 29th batch of Chinese deported from
Japan consisting of six persons arrived here at 5 a.m.
yesterday on the s.s. Hokko Maru. They were met at
the Wayside Wharf by representatives of the Overseas
Chinese Affairs Commission. They are now staying
at the Leo Kung Shing Hotel on Nantao Bund. The
Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission will issue them
relief funds to-day.

Central China Daily News (official organ of Wang Ching Wei)
(Nanking Telegram) :

REGULATIONS GOVERNING SAVINGS BANKS

In accordance with Article 14 of the
Regulations governing savings banks, the Ministry of
Finance intends to draw up measures to suppress the
issue of prizes which are given in conjunction with
deposits; to order these banks which issue prizes in
order to induce deposits to cease this practice and
to refund such sums to the depositors. The Executive
Yuan will hold a conference regarding the matter.

Summarized translation of three copies of communist handbills
which were obtained by the Municipal Police on January 28, 1935.

Jinga District - found on Carter Road, outside the Carter
Cinema, at 6.45 p.m.

(1) Handbill, undated, entitled "Manifesto in commemoration
of the 3rd anniversary of the January 28 Incident" - origin
not mentioned - alleging that the Kuomintang has sold
Charhar and urging the people to firmly oppose the attacks
of the Japanese imperialists on China and the Soviet
Union.

The document concludes with the following slogans:-
a) Down with Japan and other imperialists!
b) Down with the traitorous Kuomintang and the
Fascists!
c) Oppose the betrayal by the Kuomintang of Manchuria,
Jehol, North-China and Charhar!
d) Oppose the Fascists in cultural circles!
e) Kill reactionaries!
f) Long live the emancipation of the Chinese people!

(2) Handbill, undated, purporting to have emanated from the
"Shanghai People's Anti-Japanese & Anti-Imperialists
League", calling upon the people to rise and unite
together in order to (a) overthrow the Japanese imperialists,
the Fascist clique of the Kuomintang and the traitor
Chiang Kai Shek, (b) oppose the attacks on the Soviet
Union and (c) Support the Chinese Soviets!

Louza District - found on Nanking Road near Kin Wo Ka
at 7.13 p.m.

(3) Handbill dated January 25, 1935, entitled "Letter to the
people in commemoration of the 3rd anniversary of the
January 28 Incident in Shanghai", purporting to have
emanated from the "League of Chinese Communism", an organ
of the Trotsky Clique, denouncing the atrocities of the
Japanese imperialists and the traitorous acts of Chiang
Kai Shek and Chen Tsi Tang.

Section 2, Special Branch.
January 29, 1935.

Anniversary of the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities
in Shanghai - January 28, 1936.

Apart from the following minor incidents, the above
anniversary passed off quietly in the International
Settlement, French Concession and Chinese controlled
territory :-

At 6.45 p.m. a number of Chinese of the student
type gathered on Carter Road outside the Carter Cinema.
After letting off a cracker, they commenced distributing
communist leaflets and shouting anti-Japanese slogans.
However, upon the approach of the Police, they dispersed.
Two suspects were brought to Jinsa Station for investigation
but were later released owing to lack of evidence.

At 7.15 p.m. a quantity of communist handbills
bearing on the anniversary was thrown from the Wing On
Building onto Nanking Road. These circulars purport
to have emanated from the "League of Chinese Communism,"
an organ of the Trotsky Clique.

January 27, 1935. Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:
THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE JANUARY 28 INCIDENT
To-morrow being the third anniversary of the
January 28 Incident, the local Tangpu will hold a memorial
meeting in the Auditorium of the Tangpu Headquarters at
Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi, at 9 a.m. All public
bodies, official organs and schools have been instructed
to send representatives to the meeting.
With a view to preventing reactionary elements
from creating disturbances on that day, the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters, the Gendarmes Head-
quarters, the Peace Preservation Corps, the Chinese
Volunteer Corps and the Bureau of Public Safety will adopt
precautionary measures from 5 a.m. to midnight.
The First Special District Citizens Federation
has circularized its branches and units to detail
representatives to attend the memorial meeting to be held
under the auspices of the local Tangpu and that national
flags be hoisted at half mast and a 5-minute silence be
observed at 1.28 p.m.

一·二八事变周年纪念
明日为一·二八事变三周年纪念日，当地区党部将于上午9时在吉斯路（Route Ghisi，即今吉安路）旁凤林桥的区党部总部礼堂举行纪念大会。已指示各公共团体、官方机关和学校派代表出席会议。

commemorate the soldiers and civilians who had lost their
lives during the January 28 Incident has not yet been
completed. The First Special District Citizens' Federation
on January 27 circularized residents to proceed at 10 a.m.
to-day to Miao Hong Tseng to offer public sacrifice at
the tomb.

Fearing that reactionary elements may create
trouble, the Bureau of Public Safety has instructed its
Branches to adopt strict precautionary measures to-day
especially in Chapei. Suspicious-looking pedestrians will
be searched.

Additional Chinese and foreign detectives and
policemen will be detailed by the Settlement Police for duty
at the various intersections between the foreign Settlements
and Chinese controlled territory.

吉沪西各纱厂罢工宣言

现在的局势是更进一步的压迫剥削了！逼到无路可走的地步，我们不得不起来反抗！得到我们的利益！——我们要求：
一、承认工会；
二、增加工资；
三、改良待遇；
四、不得无故开除工人；
五、不得打骂工人；
六、不得罚工钱；
七、不得扣工钱；
八、不得强迫加班；
九、不得限制工人自由；
十、不得干涉工人行动。

我们工人的痛苦，是谁造成的？是资本家！他们为了赚钱，不顾我们的死活，把我们当作牛马看待。我们工人也是人，也有人格，也有尊严，为什么受他们的压迫？我们要团结起来，共同奋斗，争取我们的权利！

我们工人要明白，我们的敌人是资本家，不是别的工人。我们要联合起来，不分男女老少，不分籍贯，不分信仰，共同对付资本家。只有这样，我们才能取得胜利！

我们工人要有组织，有纪律，有勇气，有决心。我们要坚持到底，不达目的，誓不罢休！

我们工人要相信自己的力量，相信团结的力量。只要我们团结一致，就没有什么困难不能克服，没有什么敌人不能战胜！

我们工人要学习，要进步，要提高觉悟。我们要懂得自己的权利，懂得如何争取自己的权利。我们要用知识武装自己，用智慧战胜敌人！

我们工人要爱护自己的身体，注意卫生，保持健康。只有身体健康，才能有力气斗争，才能取得胜利！

我们工人要关心国家大事，关心社会问题。我们要为国家的独立，为民族的解放，为社会的进步而奋斗！

我们工人要发扬国际主义精神，与世界各国的工人阶级联合起来，共同反对帝国主义，反对资本主义，争取全人类的解放！

我们工人要坚信，最后的胜利一定是属于我们的！

吉沪西各纱厂全体工人

出賣華北的何應欽當了內政部長

南京國民黨政府自從把冀察政務委員會取消以後，就任命何應欽做內政部長。這個消息傳出來，全國人民都憤慨極了！因為何應欽是出賣華北的劊子手，是簽訂「何梅協定」的賣國賊！他做了內政部長，就是把中國的主權完全送給日本帝國主義了！

我們看：何應欽在簽訂「何梅協定」的時候，把河北省主席于學忠撤職，把天津市長張廷諤撤職，把憲兵第三團調走，把國民黨黨部取消，把抗日團體解散，把愛國分子逮捕殺害……這一切的一切，都是為了滿足日本帝國主義的要求！現在他又做了內政部長，這不是要把全中國都出賣給日本嗎？

全國同胞們！我們不能再沉默了！我們要起來反對何應欽做內政部長！我們要起來反對國民黨政府的賣國政策！我們要起來保衛我們的主權！我們要起來打倒日本帝國主義！

To labourers, peasants, students, soldiers and the toiling masses!

The anniversary of the January 28 Incident is
approaching again. It is the most glorious act in the history
of struggles against the imperialists of the toiling masses
in semi-colonized China. It reveals the unanimous determination
of thousands of toiling masses to put up anti-Japanese campaign,
and has also made known the unquestionable surrender of the
Nanking Government to the imperialists.

Labourers, peasants, students, soldiers and the
toiling masses! It is three years since the outbreak of the
January 28 Incident. During these three years our brethren
in the four provinces in the North-East have been groaning
under the oppression of the Japanese imperialists who treated
them like slaves. The entire North-East has been sold by
the Nanking Government to the Japanese imperialists. With the
object of securing the sympathy and understanding of other
imperialistic Powers, the Japanese have recently made energetic
efforts to occupy Chahar for use as a base to attack the
Soviet Union. Meanwhile, the British, French and American
imperialists are devising means to effect the partition and
control of the economic welfare of China.

Labourers, peasants, students, soldiers and the
toiling masses! Soviet Union is the motherland of all the
toiling masses throughout the world, and Soviet China is the
only political organization able to effect the emancipation of
the Chinese toiling masses. In order to effectively
commemorate this grand anniversary - the January 28 Incident -
we should energetically rise up and shout the following :-

1. Down with the Japanese imperialists!
2. Recover the lost territory in the North-East!
3. Down with the Nanking Government which has betrayed
the January 28 national war.

致工人、农民、学生、士兵及劳苦大众！

一·二八事变的周年纪念日再次临近。这是半殖民地中国的劳苦大众反抗帝国主义斗争史上最光荣的壮举。它揭示了成千上万劳苦大众开展抗日运动的一致决心，也暴露了南京政府对帝国主义无可置疑的投降行径。

工人、农民、学生、士兵及劳苦大众！一·二八事变爆发至今已三年。在这三年中，我们在东北四省的同胞一直在日本帝国主义的压迫下呻吟，日本人像对待奴隶一样对待他们。整个东北已被南京政府出卖给日本帝国主义。为了争取其他帝国主义列强的同情与谅解，日本人最近极力企图占领察哈尔，将其作为进攻苏联的基地。与此同时，英、法、美帝国主义正策划手段，以实现对中国经济福祉的瓜分与控制。

工人、农民、学生、士兵及劳苦大众！苏联是全世界劳苦大众的祖国，而苏维埃中国是唯一能够实现中国劳苦大众解放的政治组织。为了有效纪念这一伟大的周年纪念日——一·二八事变——我们应奋起高呼以下口号：

------

Workers throughout Shanghai! The anniversary of the
January 28 Incident is approaching again. It is three years since
our brethren in the Chapei war devastated areas were oppressed at
random and bombarded ceaselessly by the Japanese robbers. Such a
tremendous calamity is pitiable to all.
The situation in China has reached a critical stage and
the only course open to us is to strive hard for the salvation of
the nation. It is a fallacy to believe that the Nanking Government
will offer resistance to the Japanese. Chiang Kai-shek only
increases the hardships of the people. He has oppressed the masses
and levied heavy taxes on farmers. Consequently the people can
hardly maintain their livelihood. They can secure emancipation
only by joining the Chinese Soviets. As regards Manchuria, it
can be restored by nobody else other than the Red Armies and the
armed forces of the toiling masses. Let us rise up and fight
against the traitorous Kuomintang, and other reactionary "running
dogs" and drive out the Japanese imperialists from China.
Thus will the Chinese people reach the path to emancipation and true
happiness.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

MAYOR WU'S IMPORTANT REPORT ON THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE
JANUARY 28 INCIDENT

At the meeting to commemorate the January 28
Incident held by the Shanghai City Government at 9.30 a.m.
yesterday, Mayor Wu Te Chen made a report, a summarized
translation of which is as follows:-
"The situation in Shanghai during the past
three years, since the January 28 Incident, has become
somewhat normal and many improvements have been introduced.
In the first year after the war, the rehabilitation
of the district was energetically carried out with the
assistance of local citizens. In the second year,
the construction of the City Government was completed
and all work for the construction and prosperity of
the Civic Centre was taken in hand. Last year was
the third year; it was known as the civic construction
year. The City Library, the gymnasium, the athletic
field, the museum and the district hospital were
completed. This year is the 4th year and attention
will be paid to social undertakings. There are many
other matters to be considered, but as our financial
resources are limited, only a number of comparatively
important works will be proceeded with.
"Foremost of these works is the construction
of 3,000 common dwelling houses for the accommodation
of poor people. At present, large numbers of these
people are living in huts; some appear to be living
underground. We should endeavour to rescue them from
this hell. Next in importance comes the question of
the treatment of ricsha coolies whose condition is
most miserable. They have to run about under the
hot sun in summer and over snow covered roads in winter.
The first step will be for the Shanghai City Government
to take over a number of ricshas and make the City
Government and ricsha coolies operate these vehicles
as joint owners so that later on the ricsha coolies may
become owners of these vehicles.
"Development of education among the peasants
will be promoted by establishing primary schools in
villages, one at each village."

在上海市政府于昨日上午9点30分举行的一·二八事变纪念会议上，吴铁城市长作了报告，其摘要译文如下：-
“自一·二八事变以来的过去三年中，上海的局势已趋于正常，并实施了许多改进措施。战后第一年，在当地市民的协助下，积极开展了该地区的重建工作。第二年，市政府建设完成，市民中心的所有建设和繁荣工作均已着手进行。去年是第三年，被称为市政建设年。市图书馆、体育馆、运动场、博物馆和区医院均已建成。今年是第四年，将关注社会事业。尚有许多其他事项需要考虑，但由于我们的财力有限，仅会推进若干比较重要的工程。
“这些工程中，首要的是建造3000栋普通住宅，以安置贫民。目前，大量贫民居住在棚屋中；有些人似乎居住在地下。我们应努力将他们从这地狱中解救出来。其次重要的是黄包车夫待遇问题，他们的处境最为悲惨。夏天他们要在烈日下奔波，冬天要在积雪覆盖的道路上奔跑。第一步将由上海市政府接管一部分黄包车，使市政府与黄包车夫作为共同所有者运营这些车辆，以便日后黄包车夫能成为这些车辆的所有者。
“将通过在村庄建立小学来促进农民教育的发展，每个村庄一所。”

《China Evening News》及其他本地报纸：

张裕大（J.D. Chang & Company，音译）恢复营业

南京路的张裕大公司在与债权人达成谅解后，于1934年12月28日停业，于1月28日上午恢复营业。

Political (2)    January 28, 1935.

January 26 - Anniversary of Commencement of Sino-
Japanese Hostilities at Shanghai - local observance
(Continued from I.R. 26/1/35)

The 1st Special District Citizens' Federation,
Chinese Chamber of Commerce building, North Soochow
Road, issued a circular notice on January 27 to its
branches in the Settlement that apart from hoisting
flags at half mast, Chinese citizens should observe
a five minutes' silence at 1.26 p.m. on January 28.

Local Chinese radio broadcasting stations will
suspend operation. Special programmes bearing on
the occasion, however, have been arranged for the day
and evening from Chinese stations XHHZ, Rue Hennequin,
and XHHJ, Nanking Road.

The local Kuomintang has changed the venue
of the scheduled memorial meeting on the morning of
January 28 from the Young Men's Lecturing Group
building, Small West Gate, to its headquarters, Feng
Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi.

Shanghai Educational Association - meeting

Seven members of the above Association met in
their office, Dah Chih Road, Nantao, between 2.30 p.m.
and 4 p.m. January 26 and passed the following
resolutions:-

1. That a periodical entitled "Citizen' Livelihood"
be published for the perusal of labourers and
shop assistants.

2. That arrangements be made to establish a "General
Inquiry Office" in the vicinity of Shanghai North
and Shanghai South stations to afford general
information on Shanghai to countrymen and other
uneducated persons.

1月26日 - 上海中日敌对行动开始纪念日 - 本地纪念活动
（续自1935年1月26日情报报告）

第一特区市民联合会于1月27日向其在租界内的各分支机构发出通函通知，称除降半旗致哀外，中国公民应于1月28日下午1点26分默哀五分钟。

本地中文广播电台将暂停播音。然而，中文电台XHHZ（亨尼昆路，Rue Hennequin）和XHHJ（南京路）已为当天白天和晚间安排了与该场合相关的特别节目。

本地国民党已将原定于1月28日上午在小西门青年宣讲团大楼举行的纪念会议地点，改为其位于吉司菲尔路（Route Ghisi，音译）附近的凤林桥（Feng Ling Jao，音译）总部。

上海教育协会 - 会议

该协会七名成员于1月26日下午2点30分至4点之间，在南市达智路（Dah Chih Road，音译）的办事处开会，并通过以下决议：-

1. 出版一份名为《市民生活》的期刊，供劳工和店员阅读。

2. 安排在上海北站和上海南站附近设立一个“综合问询处”，为乡下人和其他未受教育人士提供关于上海的一般信息。

January 28, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of General Chiang Kai
Shek) and other local newspapers:

ANNIVERSARY OF THE JANUARY 28 INCIDENT

To-day being the 3rd Anniversary of the January
28 Incident, the local Tangpu will hold a meeting of
representatives of people of various walks of life at
10 o'clock this morning at its Headquarters, Feng Ling
Jao. The Tangpu has issued a circular notifying local
official organs, public bodies schools and the Tangpu
Branches to detail two representatives each to
participate in the memorial meeting. The national
flag will be hoisted at half-mast.
The construction by local public bodies of a
tomb to an unknown hero at Miao Hong Tseng (廟行鎮) to
commemorate the soldiers and civilians who had lost
their lives during the January 28 Incident has not yet
been completed. The First Special District Citizens'
Federation on January 27 circularized residents to
proceed at 10 a.m. to-day to Miao Hong Tseng to offer
public sacrifice at the tomb.
Fearing that reactionary elements may create
trouble, the Bureau of Public Safety has instructed its
Branches to adopt strict precautionary measures to-day
especially in Chapei. Suspicious-looking pedestrians
will be searched.
Additional Chinese and foreign detectives
and policemen will be detailed by the Settlement Police
for duty at the various intersections between the foreign
Settlements and Chinese Controlled Territory.

Shanghai Morning Post (official organ of General Chiang Kai
Shek) and other local newspapers:

FACTORY INSPECTION IN THE FRENCH CONCESSION

With reference to the opposition to the inspection
by the French Authorities of Chinese factories in the
French Concession, the Machine Made Native Goods Factory
Owners' Federation recently formed a Special Committee
to deal with the case. The inauguration of the
Committee has been fixed for to-day, but as local merchants
are very busy owing to the approach of the general
settlement of accounts, the Federation has postponed
the inauguration.
Zung Shou Chung (程守中), Chief Executive of
the Federation, yesterday discussed with Zung Hai Foong
(程海峰), Chief of the China Branch of the International
Labour Bureau, the Regulations of the French Municipal
Council governing boilers and machinery.

AN ASSOCIATION OF CITIZENS TO USE NATIVE GOODS

Zung Chi Poo (鄭志浦), Hu Siao Mei (胡少梅)
and other local civilians have promoted the formation of
an Association of Shanghai Citizens To Use Native Goods
with the object of persuading Chinese people not to use
foreign goods.
The promoters of the Association gave a reception
at 5 p.m. yesterday to reporters of newspapers and news
agencies on the 2nd floor of the Tai Chong Building (泰昌大楼),
Chekiang Road, during which a report was made on the
object of the Association.

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方机关报）及其他本地报纸：

一·二八事变周年纪念

今日为一·二八事变三周年纪念日，本地党部将于上午10时在其枫林桥总部举行各界代表会议。党部已发出通函，通知本地各政府机关、公共团体、学校及各党部支部，各派两名代表参加纪念大会。国旗将下半旗致哀。
由本地公共团体在庙行镇修建的一座无名英雄墓，以纪念在一·二八事变中丧生的军民，尚未完工。第一特区市民联合会于1月27日向居民发出通函，请于今日上午10时前往庙行镇，在墓前举行公祭。
因担心反动分子制造事端，公安局已指令其各分局在今日采取严格的预防措施，特别是在闸北地区。形迹可疑的行人将受到搜查。
租界警务处将增派中外侦探及巡捕，在外国租界与中国管辖区域交界处的各个路口执勤。

《上海晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方机关报）及其他本地报纸：

法租界工厂检查事宜

鉴于法国当局对法租界内中国工厂进行检查一事遭到反对，机制国货工厂业主联合会最近成立了一个特别委员会来处理此案。委员会的原定成立日期为今日，但由于临近年终结账期，本地商人非常忙碌，联合会已推迟了成立仪式。
该联合会执行主任程守中（Zung Shou Chung）昨日与国际劳工局中国分局局长程海峰（Zung Hai Foong）讨论了法国公董局关于锅炉和机械的规章。

市民使用国货协会

郑志浦（Zung Chi Poo）、胡少梅（Hu Siao Mei）及其他本地人士发起成立了“上海市民使用国货协会”，旨在劝说中国人不使用洋货。
该协会发起人在昨日下午5时于浙江路泰昌大楼二楼招待了报社及通讯社记者，期间介绍了该协会的宗旨。

China Times and other local newspapers

THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE JANUARY 28 INCIDENT

TO-morrow being the third anniversary of
the January 28 Incident, the local Tangpu will hold
a memorial meeting in the Auditorium of the Tangpu
Headquarters at Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi, at 9 a.m.
All public bodies, official organs and schools have
been instructed to sent representatives to the meeting.

With a view to preventing reactionary
elements from creating disturbances on that day, the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters,
the Gendarmes Headquarters, the Peace Preservation Corps,
the Chinese Volunteer Corps and the Bureau of Public
Safety will adopt precautionary measures from 5 a.m. to
midnights

The First Specil District Citizens
Federation has circularized its branches and units to
detail representatives to atted the memorial meeting to
be held under the auspices of the local Tangpu and that
national flags be hoisted at half mast and a 5-minute
silence be observed at 1.28 p.m.

一·二八事变周年纪念

明日为一·二八事变三周年纪念日，本地党部将于上午9时在吉司爱路（Route Ghisi）旁枫林桥党部总部礼堂举行纪念大会。
已指示所有公共团体、政府机关和学校派遣代表出席会议。

第一特区市民联合会已向其各分支和单位发出通函，要求派遣代表参加由本地党部主办的纪念大会，并于下午1时28分下半旗志哀，静默五分钟。

Political (3) January 26, 1938.

JANUARY 28 - ANNIVERSARY OF COMMENCEMENT OF SINO-
JAPANESE HOSTILITIES AT SHANGHAI

- Possible Observance by Communists

There are no indications that local communist
adherents will observe this anniversary beyond a
possible surreptitious dissemination of leaflets.
Additional information coming to hand will be
circulated through C.C.R..

- Commemoration by Kuomintang and other bodies

It is learned that the local Kuomintang has
received a confidential instruction from the Central
Tangbu drawing attention to the critical situation
in Eastern China and ordering the elimination of anti-
Japanese propaganda so as to avoid aggravating the
situation.

In consequence, the local Kuomintang will confine
the commemoration to a simple gathering in the Chinese
Young Men's Lecturing Group Building, Small West Gate,
at 10 a.m. when only a limited number of written posters
bearing on the occasion will be exhibited in the meeting
hall.

The local Tangbu will also insert an advertisement
in the Chinese press on January 27, instructing local
public bodies to hoist flags at half mast and the local
public to stop entertainment of any description.

As on previous occasions, Kuomintang members as
well as Government officials will wear black armbands.

政治类 (3) 1938年1月26日。

1月28日——上海中日敌对行动开始周年纪念

- 共产党人可能的纪念活动

目前没有任何迹象表明本地共产党追随者会以除可能秘密散发传单以外的方式纪念这一周年。后续获得的补充信息将通过中央登记处（C.C.R.）分发。

- 国民党及其他团体的纪念活动

据悉，本地国民党已收到来自中央党部的机密指示，提请注意华东地区的危急局势，并命令消除反日宣传，以免加剧局势。

因此，本地国民党将把纪念活动限制为上午10时在小西门中华青年会宣讲所大楼举行的一次简单集会，届时会场内仅展示少量与此次事件相关的书面海报。

本地党部还将于1月27日在中文报刊上刊登广告，指示本地公共团体下半旗，并要求本地公众停止任何形式的娱乐活动。

与以往一样，国民党党员及政府官员将佩戴黑纱臂章。
